title: ProgressNet: Sketching and Prompting with a Frozen Text-to-Image Model
title_zh: ProgressNet：基于冻结文本到图像模型的草图绘制与提示优化

paragraphs.en: Humans draw progressively: a few strokes, a look at the result, a stroke erased, a prompt revised. Image generators do not work this way. They typically take a finished sketch and produce the image in a single pass, so every edit starts the picture again, and the models that do keep state across turns are driven by text, cannot take a stroke, and are too slow to draw with. We present ProgressNet , a training-free framework that lets a frozen text-to-image model follow a drawing session as it unfolds: strokes are added and erased, the prompt is revised, and the image keeps up at about a second per turn. It needs no new parameters because the frozen model already has what a progressive generator needs, a pathway through which the previous turn can be remembered, layers that can carry appearance forward without freezing structure, and an internal signal of how far to trust an unfinished sketch; three inference-time mechanisms ( Previous-Concept Memory , Layer-Selective K/V Injection and Banded Adaptive Control ) use each in turn. As a sketch fills in, every existing method degrades, the FID of the FLUX+ControlNet baseline doubling between 10% and 100% completion on FS-COCO, while ProgressNet’s barely moves; it maintains strong fidelity and progressive coherence across three sketch domains and is preferred by users over five competitors, most widely on erasure.

paragraphs.en: Humans are visual creatures. We drew before we wrote, and drawing remains the most natural way to think through a visual idea and share it. Generative AI has opened a remarkable channel for this: a sentence now produces a picture ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) , in well under a second with few-step distillation ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Sauer et al., 2023 ) , and because a sentence is a poor description of a picture, control has steadily grown beyond text, to edges, depth and layout ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Mou et al., 2024 ) , to reference images ( Ye et al., 2023 ; Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ) , and most recently to a sketch drawn beside the prompt box ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . Sketch is the natural end of that road: it is how people convey shape and intent when words run out ( Eitz et al., 2012 ; Koley et al., 2024 ) . Yet every one of these systems takes the sketch as a finished input and produces the image in a single pass, and nobody draws that way. A drawing is made over time: a few strokes, a look, a stroke erased, a line redrawn, often a change of mind about what the picture is of ( Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 人类是视觉生物。 我们在学会书写之前就已经会绘画，而绘画仍然是思考并分享视觉概念最自然的方式。 生成式人工智能为此开辟了一个非凡的渠道：如今，一句话就能生成一幅图像（Rombach 等，2022；Black Forest Labs，2024），整个过程只需不到一秒，且可通过少步蒸馏实现（Luo 等，2023；Sauer 等，2023）。由于文字难以准确描述图像，控制手段也逐步从文本扩展到边缘、深度和布局（Zhang 等，2023；Mou 等，2024），再到参考图像（Ye 等，2023；Black Forest Labs 等，2025），最近甚至扩展到了提示框旁绘制的一幅草图（OpenAI，2026）。 草图正是这一发展路径的自然终点：当语言不足以表达时，人们便通过草图来传达形状和意图（Eitz 等，2012；Koley 等，2024）。 然而，所有这些系统都将草图视为一个完整的输入，并一次性生成图像，而现实中没有人是这样绘画的。 一幅画是随着时间逐步完成的：几笔勾勒、一次观察、一笔擦除、一条线重绘，甚至常常伴随着对画面内容的重新思考（图1）。

This paper is about that interaction. ProgressNet lets a frozen text-to-image model support all of it, drawing, erasing and prompt revision, at about a second per turn and with no training.

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, no existing system does all. Sketch-conditioned generation ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Koley et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) is stateless: each turn regenerates the scene from nothing, so appearance drifts with every stroke and an erased stroke leaves a ghost, because nothing withdraws the evidence it added ( Fig. 2 ). Interactive sketch systems lower the cost of regeneration without removing its statelessness ( Sarukkai et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2024 ) , and Subjective Camera ( Chen et al., 2025b ) follows a drawing order by latent optimisation that takes minutes per scene. Image editing models ( Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) do handle turn-by-turn interaction, but for a different kind of turn: the image enters as a second token stream in joint attention and the change is given in words, so there is no pathway for a stroke map and no way to say that a stroke is gone, and tens of denoising steps over a doubled sequence make each turn take seconds rather than the fraction of a second a drawing person will wait. ProgressNet therefore builds on the architecture that accepts strokes, a frozen flow-matching backbone with a ControlNet, and stays in the few-step regime that makes interaction possible.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，目前没有任何系统能够完成所有这些功能。 基于草图的生成方法（Zhang 等，2023；Koley 等，2024；Li 等，2024）是无状态的：每次迭代都从零开始重新生成场景，因此外观会随着每一笔绘制而漂移，而被擦除的笔触会留下“残影”，因为没有任何机制能撤销其添加的证据（图 2）。 交互式草图系统降低了重新生成的成本，但并未消除其无状态特性（Sarukkai 等，2024；Song 等，2024）；而“主观相机”方法（Chen 等，2025b）则通过潜变量优化来遵循绘制顺序，每幅场景仅需几分钟时间。 图像编辑模型（Black Forest Labs 等，2025；Zhou 等，2025；Liao 等，2026；Xu 等，2026）确实支持逐轮交互，但交互方式不同：图像作为联合注意力中的第二个词元流输入，修改则通过文字描述给出。因此，既没有笔触映射的路径，也没有办法明确表示某一笔触已被移除；此外，在长度加倍的序列上执行数十步降噪操作，使得每轮交互需要数秒时间，而非绘图者所能忍受的短暂等待。 因此，ProgressNet 基于能够接收笔触输入、采用冻结流匹配主干网络与 ControlNet 结合的建筑框架，并保持在使交互成为可能的小步数操作范围内。

paragraphs.en: Following a drawing session with a frozen model raises three problems, and each has a simple answer inside the model. Remembering. The model must remember what it generated last turn. The ControlNet’s tile branch accepts an RGB image, so the previous output can be fed back as an explicit appearance memory, and because that memory lives in pixel space the user’s operations map onto it directly: an added stroke keeps it, an erased stroke white-fills its region, a new prompt relaxes the regions the user has not committed to ( Previous-Concept Memory , PCM; Section 4.1 ). Carrying forward. The model must carry that memory without freezing what should change. Training-free editors inject cached attention at the layers most vital to forming the image ( Avrahami et al., 2025 ) ; under progression those are exactly the layers that must absorb new strokes, and locking them yields images that stop responding as the drawing grows. Injecting at the least vital layers instead keeps appearance while structure stays free ( Layer-Selective K/V Injection , LS-KVI; Section 4.2 ). Trusting the sketch. The model must balance adherence to an unfinished sketch with preservation of previous appearance. We regulate this balance indirectly, using changes in cached ControlNet memory features between the two preceding completed turns to modulate memory strength across layer bands and solver steps, while structural control remains fixed (Banded Adaptive Control, BAC; Section 4.3 ). Together the three add 0.068 0.068 s to a two-step FLUX generation.

paragraphs.en: Controllable image generation spans ControlNet-style residual conditioning ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , multi-condition control ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , lightweight adapters ( Mou et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2023 ) , layout grounding ( Li et al., 2023b ; Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ) , and training-free feature steering ( Mo et al., 2024 ; Tumanyan et al., 2023 ) , recently ported to DiT and rectified-flow backbones ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs, 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) . Inversion-based editing ( Hertz et al., 2023 ) , attention injection ( Avrahami et al., 2025 ) , and few-step distillation ( Song et al., 2024 ; Sauer et al., 2023 ) improve editability and latency, bringing sketch interaction near real time ( Sarukkai et al., 2024 ) . Others mitigate text-sketch conflict by re-weighting cross-attention ( Chefer et al., 2023 ; Phung et al., 2024 ) or rescaling the control residual ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Cohen et al., 2025 ) . All operate single-shot: none tracks how sketch–text conflict evolves across turns, nor preserves prior content as the condition changes. ProgressNet targets this non-stationary setting via training-free temporal memory, selective feature reuse, and ControlNet-driven adaptive control, detailed in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 可控图像生成涵盖了 ControlNet 风格的残差条件约束（Zhang et al., 2023）、多条件控制（Zhao et al., 2023）、轻量级适配器（Mou et al., 2024；Ye et al., 2023）、布局定位（Li et al., 2023b；Bar-Tal et al., 2023）以及无需训练的特征引导（Mo et al., 2024；Tumanyan et al., 2023），这些方法近期已被迁移至 DiT 和 rectified-flow 主干网络（Esser et al., 2024；Black Forest Labs, 2024；Tan et al., 2025）。 基于反演的编辑（Hertz et al., 2023）、注意力注入（Avrahami et al., 2025）以及少步蒸馏（Song et al., 2024；Sauer et al., 2023）提升了编辑能力和响应延迟，使草图交互接近实时水平（Sarukkai et al., 2024）。 其他方法通过重新加权交叉注意力（Chefer et al., 2023；Phung et al., 2024）或重新缩放控制残差（Liu et al., 2024；Cohen et al., 2025）来缓解文本与草图之间的冲突。 所有这些方法均为单次操作：它们既无法追踪草图与文本冲突在多次交互中的演变过程，也无法在条件变化时保留先前的内容。 ProgressNet 通过无需训练的时间记忆、选择性特征复用以及由 ControlNet 驱动的自适应控制来应对这种非平稳场景，相关细节见附录 E。

This formulation also makes the control strength λ \lambda a critical factor under few-step inference, where over- or under-conditioning cannot be corrected over many denoising steps ( Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: ProgressNet 基于流匹配主干网络（Black Forest Labs，2024；Bandyopadhyay 等，2025；Lipman 等，2023），并结合了 Union ControlNet。 对潜在令牌和上下文令牌的联合注意力机制揭示了 K/V 特征，这些特征随后被 LS-KVI（第 4.2 节）复用，而空间条件（如 Canny 边缘和图块记忆）则通过 ControlNet 的残差引入，即 𝐡 ′ = 𝐡 + λ ​ 𝐫 \mathbf{h}^{\prime}=\mathbf{h}+\lambda\mathbf{r}。 这种公式也使得控制强度 λ \lambda 成为少步推理中的关键因素，因为在这样的推理中，过度或不足的条件约束无法通过多次去噪步骤进行修正（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Our pilot studies ( Figs. 3a and 3b ) show that existing formulations struggle to maintain a coherent progressive state: appearance can drift between turns, a fixed control strength can either imprint partial strokes too strongly or under-enforce them, and erased content may persist when the sketch is revised. ProgressNet addresses these coupled failures through explicit concept memory, selective temporal feature reuse, and adaptive control modulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的初步研究（图 3a 和 3b）表明，现有方法难以维持连贯的渐进状态：外观可能在不同回合之间发生偏移，固定的控制强度要么会过度强化部分笔触，要么无法有效执行，而且在草图修订时，被擦除的内容可能仍然存在。 ProgressNet 通过显式概念记忆、选择性时间特征重用和自适应控制调制，解决了这些相互关联的问题。

paragraphs.en: Overview. Given a sketch 𝐒 t \mathbf{S}_{t} , prompt P t P_{t} , and previous output I t − 1 I_{t-1} , we generate I t = 𝒢 ⁡ ( 𝐒 t , P t , I t − 1 , θ ) I_{t}=\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{S}_{t},P_{t},I_{t-1};\theta) while keeping pretrained weights θ \theta frozen and supporting stroke addition, removal, and prompt updates. paragraphs.en: PCM anchors successive generations via memory conditioning, but internal representations can still drift as attention is recomputed at each step. paragraphs.en: From image editing to progressive control. Progressive generation differs from text-guided editing. In editing, feature injection preserves a source image while text updates selected semantics. In progressive control, each turn adds a new spatial signal via ControlNet, and new strokes may change geometry, pose, or even the concept. Carrying strong previous-turn features through influential layers can thus conflict with the current structure and over-preserve content that should evolve, as we observe when adapting vital-layer injection to progressive sketching ( Fig. 5 ). This suggests a different principle: progressive generation should not freeze the layers most responsible for forming the current concept. We therefore leave vital layers without direct temporal K/V injection and reuse features at selected lower-vitality layers, assessing the resulting preservation and adaptation empirically.
paragraphs.zh: 从图像编辑到渐进式控制。 渐进式生成与文本引导编辑有所不同。 在编辑中，特征注入会保留源图像，同时通过文本更新选定的语义内容。 在渐进式控制中，每一步都会通过 ControlNet 添加新的空间信号，而新的笔触可能会改变几何结构、姿态，甚至整个概念。 因此，将前一步的强特征通过关键层传递下来，可能会与当前结构产生冲突，并过度保留本应演化的内容；正如我们在将关键层注入方法应用于渐进式草图绘制时所观察到的那样（图 5）。 这表明了一种不同的原则：渐进式生成不应冻结那些对形成当前概念负有主要责任的层。 因此，我们没有在关键层上进行直接的时间 K/V 注入，而是选择在较低重要性的层上复用特征，并通过实证评估由此产生的保留效果与适应能力。

paragraphs.en: PCM and LS-KVI preserve information across turns, but PCM retains a fixed memory-control strength. During progressive sketching, however, how strongly the preceding appearance should constrain the current generation changes as new structural evidence arrives. paragraphs.en: Evaluation Protocol and Metrics. We evaluate generation quality at specific sketch-completion stages (Table 1 ) and progressive stability across representative transitions (Table 2 ), while preserving stroke order and captions. We measure distributional quality with FID-I ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) and FID-C ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2023 ) , semantic fidelity with DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , and text alignment with CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ; Radford et al., 2021 ) and T5-Cos (BLIP-2 captions ( Li et al., 2023a ) + T5 embeddings ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) ). For progression, PFC-DINO and PFC-LPIPS measure temporal stability. We additionally report quality-adjusted cross-completion robustness in distributional (Dist.), visual (Vis.), textual (Text), and overall dimensions, normalized to the FLUX baseline ( 100 100 ). Full definitions are provided in Appendix A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 评估协议与指标。 我们在特定的草图完成阶段（表 1）以及代表性转换过程中的渐进稳定性（表 2）上对生成质量进行评估，同时保留笔划顺序和说明文字。 我们使用 FID-I（Heusel et al., 2017）和 FID-C（Kynkäänniemi et al., 2023）衡量分布质量，使用 DINOv2（Oquab et al., 2024）衡量语义保真度，并使用 CLIPScore（Hessel et al., 2021; Radford et al., 2021）和 T5-Cos（BLIP-2 说明文字（Li et al., 2023a）+ T5 嵌入（Raffel et al., 2020））衡量文本对齐度。 在渐进性方面，PFC-DINO 和 PFC-LPIPS 用于衡量时间稳定性。 我们还报告了质量调整后的跨完成鲁棒性，涵盖分布（Dist.）、视觉（Vis.）、文本（Text）和整体维度，并归一化为 FLUX 基线（100 100）。 完整定义见附录 A.2。

paragraphs.en: Figs. 8 and 8 examine how progressive memory supports generation as the sketch is continuously extended, revised, or locally edited. In Fig. 8 , comparisons against standard baselines show that ProgressNet better preserves appearance and scene context during progressive sketching and remains coherent when previously drawn strokes are removed. Fig. 8 extends this evaluation to cross-method comparisons and more demanding interactions against Nano Banana Pro, including fine-grained giraffe and scene-level edits as well as open-ended creative generation. These examples also show reduced temporal drift and stroke-induced artifacts under progressive updates. Across these cases, the progressive sketching process allows local structure to evolve without repeatedly reinterpreting the established image, while the retained visual state provides an important basis for subsequent edits. Together, these illustrate the practical benefit of progressive memory: users can incrementally develop, revise, and refine an image while preserving the context established earlier.

paragraphs.en: We proposed ProgressNet, a training-free framework for progressive generation that stabilizes interactions between evolving strokes and prompts. PCM and LS-KVI preserve temporal consistency, while BAC uses retrospective memory-feature divergence to adapt memory. ProgressNet enables progressive drawing by improving fidelity and alignment across completion levels with near-real-time performance. Our work opens avenues for more modality-agnostic progressive generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ProgressNet，一个无需训练的渐进式生成框架，能够稳定演化笔触与提示词之间的交互。 PCM 和 LS-KVI 可保持时间一致性，而 BAC 则利用回顾性记忆特征差异来适应记忆。 ProgressNet 通过提升各完成阶段的保真度和对齐度，实现了渐进式绘制，且性能接近实时。 我们的工作为更多模态无关的渐进式生成开辟了新的途径。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three complementary sketch domains using fixed evaluation subsets and identical inputs for every compared method. FS-COCO ( Chowdhury et al., 2022 ) contributes 10,000 temporally ordered freehand scene sketches with paired photographs and captions. Photo-Sketching ( Li et al., 2019 ) contributes 500 contour-sketch/image pairs from its 5,000 available pairs. Sketchy ( Sangkloy et al., 2016 ) contributes 1,250 single-object freehand sketches, stratified uniformly across all 125 categories with 10 samples per category. The resulting generation-quality evaluation contains 11,750 samples. For each sample, the ordered sketch sequence and associated text condition are fixed once and shared across all methods; progressive states are evaluated at { 10 , 20 , 30 , 50 , 70 , 80 , 100 } % \{10,20,30,50,70,80,100\}\% completion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用固定的评估子集和所有对比方法相同的输入，对三个互补的草图领域进行评估。 FS-COCO（Chowdhury 等人，2022）提供了 10,000 幅按时间顺序排列的自由手绘场景草图，并配有配对的照片和说明文字。 Photo-Sketching（Li 等人，2019）从其可用的 5,000 对图像中提供了 500 对轮廓草图/图像。 Sketchy（Sangkloy 等人，2016）提供了 1,250 幅单物体自由手绘草图，这些草图在所有 125 个类别中均匀分层，每个类别包含 10 个样本。 最终的生成质量评估包含 11,750 个样本。 对于每个样本，有序的草图序列和相关的文本条件一旦被固定便在所有方法中共享；渐进状态在 {10, 20, 30, 50, 70, 80, 100}% 的完成度上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: FID-I and FID-C measure distributional quality in Inception and CLIP image-feature spaces, respectively; DINOv2 measures paired visual-semantic fidelity, while CLIPScore and T5-Cos assess text alignment. We therefore interpret temporal and fidelity metrics jointly, complemented by qualitative and operation-level evaluations. From 30% completion onward on FS-COCO, the full system (PCM + LS-KVI + BAC) obtains the strongest FID-C and remains at or above the other ablation variants on CLIPScore and T5-Cos across the reported stages ( Tables 7 and 4 ). Its FID-C remains low and stable across 30–100% completion (0.144, 0.141, 0.142, 0.141, 0.143), while CLIPScore and T5-Cos remain competitive throughout. Together, the full system maintains strong FID-I while improving FID-C and textual alignment across later completion stages; the qualitative BAC analysis separately examines difficult sketch–prompt configurations.
paragraphs.zh: FID-I 和 FID-C 分别衡量 Inception 和 CLIP 图像特征空间中的分布质量；DINOv2 衡量视觉与语义之间的成对保真度，而 CLIPScore 和 T5-Cos 则评估文本对齐程度。 因此，我们将时间相关指标和保真度指标进行联合解读，并辅以定性评估和操作层面的评估。 在 FS-COCO 数据集上，从 30% 的完成度开始，完整系统（PCM + LS-KVI + BAC）获得了最高的 FID-C 值，并且在报告的所有阶段中，其 CLIPScore 和 T5-Cos 表现均不低于其他消融变体（见表 7 和表 4）。 在 30%–100% 的完成度范围内，其 FID-C 保持较低且稳定（0.144、0.141、0.142、0.141、0.143），而 CLIPScore 和 T5-Cos 在整个过程中均保持竞争力。 综合来看，完整系统在后期完成阶段既保持了较高的 FID-I，又提升了 FID-C 和文本对齐效果；定性的 BAC 分析则单独考察了具有挑战性的草图–提示配置。

paragraphs.en: PCM derives its commitment mask C t C_{t} from the processed current sketch. We combine a dilated stroke-proximity support with flood-filled enclosed regions; the resulting mask marks content that should remain committed under subsequent interaction. For stroke addition, the previous output is used unchanged as memory. For stroke removal, evidence inside the erased region is withdrawn by neutral white filling before tile conditioning. For prompt updates, committed content is preserved while uncommitted regions are replaced by the neutral gray prior, as defined in Eq. 1 of the main paper. The same mask construction is used for all datasets and all interaction sequences.

paragraphs.en: The soft commitment mask combines two complementary supports. For stroke-proximity support, pixels with grayscale intensity below 200 200 are treated as sketch pixels, dilated by 24 24 pixels using an elliptical kernel, and Gaussian-smoothed with a 41 × 41 41\times 41 kernel. For enclosed regions, we first morphologically close sketch gaps using a 17 × 17 17\times 17 elliptical kernel, corresponding to an 8 8 -pixel closing radius. We then flood-fill the exterior from the image boundary and retain the non-exterior region as the enclosed support, followed by Gaussian smoothing with a 21 × 21 21\times 21 kernel. The final commitment mask is the pixelwise maximum of the proximity and enclosed-region supports and is clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . These parameters are held fixed throughout all reported experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 软承诺掩膜结合了两种互补的支持区域。 对于临近笔划的支持区域，灰度强度低于 200 的像素被视为草图像素，使用椭圆核进行 24 像素的膨胀处理，并用 41×41 的核进行高斯平滑。 对于封闭区域，我们首先使用 17×17 的椭圆核对草图中的间隙进行形态学闭合操作，该核对应于 8 像素的闭合半径。 接着，我们从图像边界开始向外进行洪水填充，将非外部区域保留为封闭支持区域，然后使用 21×21 的核进行高斯平滑。 最终的承诺掩膜是临近笔划支持区域与封闭区域支持区域的逐像素最大值，并将其裁剪至 [0, 1] 范围内。 在所有报告的实验中，这些参数均保持固定不变。

paragraphs.en: We quantitatively evaluate stroke removal on 100 FS-COCO sequences using a controlled S 50 → S 70 → S 50 S_{50}\!\rightarrow\!S_{70}\!\rightarrow\!S_{50} add–erase cycle, where the final sketch is identical to the initial 50 % 50\% state. We additionally report error inside the erased region and appearance change outside it. Invalidating stale LS-KVI state reduces return LPIPS by 30.9 % 30.9\% and improves recovery in 93 / 100 93/100 sequences (paired Wilcoxon p = 7.1 × 10 − 15 p=7.1{\times}10^{-15} ). It also reduces erased-region error in 91 / 100 91/100 cases, showing that stale temporal correspondences can resist destructive updates.

paragraphs.en: We compare four divergence measures for computing the BAC correction factor: cosine similarity, KL divergence, Jensen–Shannon divergence (JSD), and channel-wise JSD. Fig. 12 presents qualitative results on an out-of-distribution sketch from a stroke-based drawing agent, Pixelor ( Bhunia et al., 2020 ) . Without any correction (W/o BAC), the generation retains a solid background with visible sketch-edge artifacts. KL and standard JSD show stronger visible distortions at higher completion levels. Cosine similarity yields cleaner outputs but still transfers fine sketch details into the generated image.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了四种用于计算 BAC 校正因子的差异度量：余弦相似度、KL 散度、Jensen–Shannon 散度（JSD）以及通道级 JSD。 图 12 展示了一项基于笔触的绘画智能体 Pixelor（Bhunia 等人，2020）生成的分布外草图的定性结果。 在没有进行任何校正（W/o BAC）的情况下，生成结果保留了实色的背景，并出现了可见的草图边缘伪影。 KL 散度和标准 JSD 在较高的完成度下表现出更明显的可见失真。 余弦相似度能产生更干净的输出，但仍会将精细的草图细节转移到生成的图像中。

paragraphs.en: ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) established spatial conditioning through auxiliary branches attached to frozen diffusion backbones, and subsequent works expanded controllability through unified multi-condition models ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Qin et al., 2023 ) , lightweight conditioning adapters ( Mou et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2023 ) , feedback-based control architectures ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zavadski et al., 2024 ) , grounded and regional generation ( Li et al., 2023b ; Xie et al., 2023 ; Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ) , and training-free feature manipulation ( Mo et al., 2024 ; Tumanyan et al., 2023 ) . Sketch-based conditioning has similarly progressed through dedicated sketch-to-image and interactive systems ( Sarukkai et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2024 ) toward increasingly general conditional generators. These developments largely assume a condition that is already sufficiently specified before generation begins.
paragraphs.zh: ControlNet（Zhang 等人，2023）通过附加在冻结扩散主干上的辅助分支建立了空间条件约束，后续研究则通过统一的多条件模型（Zhao 等人，2023；Qin 等人，2023）、轻量级条件适配器（Mou 等人，2024；Ye 等人，2023）、基于反馈的控制架构（Li 等人，2024；Zavadski 等人，2024）、基于现实和区域生成的方法（Li 等人，2023b；Xie 等人，2023；Bar-Tal 等人，2023），以及无需训练的特征操控技术（Mo 等人，2024；Tumanyan 等人，2023）扩展了可控性。 基于草图的条件约束方法也取得了类似进展，通过专门的草图到图像转换系统和交互式系统（Sarukkai 等人，2024；Song 等人，2024），逐步发展为更具通用性的条件生成器。 这些发展在很大程度上假设在生成开始之前，条件已经得到了充分明确。

paragraphs.en: The transition from UNet diffusion to DiT and rectified-flow architectures ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) has further changed how spatial conditions are injected. Ctrl-Adapter ( Lin et al., 2025 ) bridges pretrained ControlNets to newer diffusion backbones, OminiControl ( Tan et al., 2025 ) introduces lightweight universal control for FLUX, and SemanticDraw ( Lee et al., 2025 ) supports real-time multi-region interaction. ControlNet-XS ( Zavadski et al., 2024 ) and ControlNet++ ( Li et al., 2024 ) likewise revisit the interaction between the conditioning pathway and the generator. While these methods considerably expand what can be controlled, their conditioning remains predominantly generation-centric rather than progression-centric: the model receives the current condition, but does not explicitly reason about what should remain stable from the preceding interaction turn. ProgressNet instead treats the previous concept as part of the state of generation and explicitly distinguishes stroke addition, removal, and prompt reinterpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 从 UNet 扩散模型向 DiT 和 rectified-flow 架构（Peebles & Xie, 2023；Esser et al., 2024；Black Forest Labs, 2024）的过渡，进一步改变了空间条件注入的方式。 Ctrl-Adapter（Lin et al., 2025）将预训练的 ControlNet 与更新的扩散主干模型连接起来；OminiControl（Tan et al., 2025）为 FLUX 引入了轻量级的通用控制机制；而 SemanticDraw（Lee et al., 2025）则支持实时多区域交互。 ControlNet-XS（Zavadski et al., 2024）和 ControlNet++（Li et al., 2024）同样重新审视了条件路径与生成器之间的交互方式。 尽管这些方法显著扩展了可控制的内容，但其条件机制仍以生成为中心，而非以进展为中心：模型接收当前条件，但并未明确推理哪些内容应从前一个交互回合中保持稳定。 相比之下，ProgressNet 将前一个概念视为生成状态的一部分，并明确区分了笔触的添加、移除以及对提示的重新解释。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion editing has been extensively studied through inversion and attention manipulation ( Hertz et al., 2023 ; Meng et al., 2022 ; Couairon et al., 2023 ; Kawar et al., 2023 ; Mokady et al., 2023 ) , inpainting ( Avrahami et al., 2023 ; Lugmayr et al., 2022 ; Suvorov et al., 2022 ) , instruction-based editing ( Brooks et al., 2023 ) , and personalization ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Ruiz et al., 2023 ; Gal et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ) . Such methods enable semantic or regional modification but generally solve each edit as a fresh optimization, inversion, or generation problem rather than maintaining a persistent state across a long interaction sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散编辑已通过反演和注意力操控（Hertz 等，2023；Meng 等，2022；Couairon 等，2023；Kawar 等，2023；Mokady 等，2023）、内容填充（Avrahami 等，2023；Lugmayr 等，2022；Suvorov 等，2022）、基于指令的编辑（Brooks 等，2023）以及个性化（Hu 等，2022；Ruiz 等，2023；Gal 等，2023；Kumari 等，2023）得到了广泛研究。 这类方法虽然能够实现语义或区域性的修改，但通常将每次编辑视为一个全新的优化、反演或生成问题来解决，而不是在较长的交互序列中维持一个持续的状态。

paragraphs.en: Few-step and distilled generation substantially reduce this cost. Latent Consistency Models ( Luo et al., 2023 ) , SDXS ( Song et al., 2024 ) , NitroFusion ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , SDXL-Turbo ( Sauer et al., 2023 ) , and StreamDiffusion ( Kodaira et al., 2025 ) push inference toward interactive rates. However, low latency alone does not imply temporal consistency: regenerating from a changed sketch can alter previously established identity, appearance, geometry, or background even when the newly introduced stroke is local. Among interactive sketch systems, Block-and-Detail ( Sarukkai et al., 2024 ) stabilizes generation through coarse-to-fine re-noising, whereas SDXS ( Song et al., 2024 ) provides one-step image-conditioned synthesis; both remain vulnerable to drift when the conditioning evolves progressively.
paragraphs.zh: 少步生成和蒸馏生成能显著降低这一成本。 潜在一致性模型（Luo 等，2023）、SDXS（Song 等，2024）、NitroFusion（Chen 等，2025a）、SDXL-Turbo（Sauer 等，2023）和 StreamDiffusion（Kodaira 等，2025）正推动推理向交互式速率发展。 然而，低延迟本身并不等同于时间一致性：即使新添加的笔触是局部的，从修改后的草图重新生成也可能改变先前已确立的身份、外观、几何结构或背景。 在交互式草图系统中，Block-and-Detail（Sarukkai 等，2024）通过由粗到细的重新加噪来稳定生成，而 SDXS（Song 等，2024）则提供了一步图像条件合成；但当条件逐步变化时，两者仍容易受到漂移的影响。

paragraphs.en: Recent training-free editing methods are particularly related to our temporal component. StableFlow ( Avrahami et al., 2025 ) identifies vital transformer layers and reuses internal features to preserve content during editing, while FluxSpace ( Dalva et al., 2025 ) exposes semantic directions in rectified-flow representations and FLUX.1 Kontext ( Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ) enables iterative in-context editing. Related feature-reuse mechanisms have also been explored for consistency through cross-image or temporal attention ( Alaluf et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Qi et al., 2023 ) . These works demonstrate that internal attention features provide a strong substrate for consistency, but progressive sketching requires a different balance: preserving all influential layers too strongly can suppress newly drawn structure. This motivates our Layer-Selective K/V Injection, which preserves temporal information only through non-vital layers while leaving structurally important layers free to adapt.
paragraphs.zh: 近期无需训练即可进行编辑的方法与我们的时间组件尤为相关。 StableFlow（Avrahami 等人，2025）识别出关键变换器层，并复用内部特征以在编辑过程中保留内容；而 FluxSpace（Dalva 等人，2025）则揭示了修正流表示和 FLUX.1 Kontext（Black Forest Labs 等人，2025）中的语义方向，从而支持迭代式的上下文内编辑。 相关的特征复用机制也已被用于通过跨图像或时间注意力来确保一致性（Alaluf 等人，2024；Cao 等人，2023；Qi 等人，2023）。 这些研究表明，内部注意力特征为一致性提供了坚实的基础，但渐进式草图绘制需要不同的平衡：若过度保留所有关键层，可能会抑制新绘制的结构。 这启发我们提出了“层选择式 K/V 注入”方法，该方法仅通过非关键层保留时间信息，同时让结构重要的层保持自由适应。

paragraphs.en: A separate literature studies the failure of text and visual conditions to remain semantically aligned. Text-to-image models exhibit semantic neglect, incorrect attribute binding, and word-to-concept mismatch ( Rassin et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , with such failures analyzed through cross-attention ( Tang et al., 2023 ) and latent-space representations ( Ramos et al., 2025 ) . Structured Diffusion ( Feng et al., 2023 ) decomposes prompts for improved compositionality, while Attend-and-Excite ( Chefer et al., 2023 ) , Linguistic Binding ( Rassin et al., 2023 ) , and Attention Refocusing ( Phung et al., 2024 ) intervene on attention to improve semantic correspondence.
paragraphs.zh: 另有文献研究了文本与视觉条件未能保持语义对齐的问题。 文本到图像模型表现出语义忽视、属性绑定错误以及词-概念不匹配等问题（Rassin 等，2022；Wang 等，2024），这些失败可通过交叉注意力（Tang 等，2023）和潜在空间表示（Ramos 等，2025）进行分析。 结构化扩散模型（Feng 等，2023）通过分解提示词来提升组合性，而“关注与激发”模型（Chefer 等，2023）、语言绑定模型（Rassin 等，2023）和注意力重聚焦模型（Phung 等，2024）则通过干预注意力机制来改善语义对应关系。

paragraphs.en: More directly related to ProgressNet, SmartControl ( Liu et al., 2024 ) adapts ControlNet behavior under rough or unreliable visual conditions, while Text-Anchored Score Composition ( Wang et al., 2024 ) explicitly addresses conflict between textual and spatial conditions. Conditional Balance ( Cohen et al., 2025 ) controls competing conditioning signals through selective feature manipulation, and training-free alternatives such as Ctrl-X ( Lin et al., 2024 ) and FreeControl ( Mo et al., 2024 ) regulate structure and appearance without conventional task-specific training. Collectively, these methods show that a single fixed global control scale is insufficient when text and structural evidence disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 与 ProgressNet 更直接相关的是，SmartControl（Liu 等人，2024）在视觉条件粗糙或不可靠的情况下调整了 ControlNet 的行为，而 Text-Anchored Score Composition（Wang 等人，2024）则明确解决了文本条件与空间条件之间的冲突。 Conditional Balance（Cohen 等人，2025）通过选择性特征操控来控制相互竞争的约束信号，而无需训练的替代方法，如 Ctrl-X（Lin 等人，2024）和 FreeControl（Mo 等人，2024），则能在没有传统任务特定训练的情况下调节结构和外观。 总体而言，这些方法表明，当文本证据与结构证据不一致时，仅使用一个固定的全局控制尺度是不够的。

paragraphs.en: Progressive sketching makes this conflict substantially more difficult because the disagreement itself changes over time. A sparse early contour may be highly ambiguous or even contradict the prompt, whereas later strokes can progressively resolve the intended geometry. The appropriate strength of control can therefore vary across interaction turns, architectural layers, and denoising steps. Our pilot analysis further shows that ControlNet perturbations are step- and band-asymmetric and that large inter-turn feature redistribution accompanies structurally disruptive stroke updates. ProgressNet exploits this behavior through Banded Adaptive Control (BAC), deriving step- and band-specific correction factors from retrospective comparisons of cached tile-memory ControlNet features across preceding turns. Unlike learned control policies ( Liu et al., 2024 ) or manually selected control locations ( Cohen et al., 2025 ) , BAC derives its modulation directly from the evolving control representation and requires no additional training.
paragraphs.zh: 渐进式草图绘制使这一冲突变得显著更复杂，因为分歧本身会随时间变化。 稀疏的早期轮廓可能高度模糊，甚至与提示相矛盾，而后续笔触则能逐步明确预期的几何结构。 因此，适当的控制强度可能会在不同交互轮次、架构层和去噪步骤中发生变化。 我们的初步分析还表明，ControlNet 的扰动在步骤和频段上是不对称的，并且结构破坏性的笔触更新会伴随大规模的特征跨轮次重新分布。 ProgressNet 通过带状自适应控制（BAC）利用这一特性，从先前轮次中缓存的图块内存 ControlNet 特征的回顾性比较中，推导出特定于步骤和频段的修正因子。 与学习型控制策略（Liu et al., 2024）或手动选择的控制位置（Cohen et al., 2025）不同，BAC 直接从不断演化的控制表示中获取调制，且无需额外训练。

paragraphs.en: Nano Banana Pro, a commercial image-generation and editing model by Google DeepMind, is included as a qualitative reference in Fig. 8 of the main paper. For fine-grained spatial-control comparisons, the same sketch and text instruction were supplied through its public chat interface, with an explicit request to follow the sketch structure. Because the system is proprietary and does not expose the controlled inference protocol required by our completion-level evaluation, we do not include it in the quantitative tables. The comparison is therefore intended only to illustrate differences in interactive sketch adherence under the available interface, not to establish a controlled benchmark ranking.
paragraphs.zh: Nano Banana Pro 是 Google DeepMind 推出的一款商用图像生成与编辑模型，作为定性参考被纳入主论文的图 8。 为了进行精细的空间控制对比，我们通过其公开聊天接口提供了相同的草图和文本指令，并明确要求遵循草图结构。 由于该系统属于专有系统，且未开放我们完成度评估所需的受控推理协议，因此我们未将其纳入定量表格中。 因此，此次对比仅旨在说明在现有接口条件下，各模型对交互式草图的遵循程度差异，而非建立受控的基准排名。

paragraphs.en: We provide additional qualitative comparisons against the strongest competing methods, with all examples drawn from FS-COCO ( Chowdhury et al., 2022 ) , which offers a diverse set of single-object, multi-object, and scene-level sketches paired with reference photographs. This diversity allows a thorough evaluation of temporal coherence, sketch faithfulness, and semantic fidelity across several completion levels. For readability, these extended figures focus on SDXS, FLUX+ControlNet, and StableFlow, which represent one-step image-conditioned synthesis, stateless structural control, and strong temporal feature locking, respectively; the full six-method comparison is reported quantitatively in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了与最强竞争方法之间的额外定性比较，所有示例均取自 FS-COCO（Chowdhury 等人，2022），该数据集包含多样化的单对象、多对象和场景级草图，并配有参考照片。 这种多样性使得能够全面评估在不同完成级别下的时间连贯性、草图保真度和语义忠实度。 为便于阅读，这些扩展图表重点关注 SDXS、FLUX+ControlNet 和 StableFlow，它们分别代表了一步图像条件合成、无状态结构控制和强时间特征锁定；完整的六种方法比较在正文中以定量形式报告。
